name: Unfold
title: Unfold | Amplifier Smart Tools
promise: Make an idea clear through motion.
description: Turn a technical explanation into an animation. Describe the relationships that matter, watch the result, and refine the exact moment that needs to be clearer.
alt: A neural-network explanation, followed by the real Unfold workspace playing From spark to system and a zoom into its Make ideas move ending.
caption: Describe it to your agent. Make it with Unfold. Review and refine together.
flow_title: Explain it. Watch it. Make it clearer.
flow_intro: Use geometry, images, text, and movement to make a system or idea easier to understand.
steps: Describe the audience, the idea, and the real relationships between components. Add visual guidance and supplied assets.
Review a revision on its own or compare two with synchronized playback. Earlier revisions remain available.
Leave feedback on a moment or interval. Share visual guidance and eligible assets in identity packs, then deliver a video or transparent overlay.
detail_title: Keep the idea and its history.
details: Attach feedback to the point that needs work. Authorized refinement can run from the workspace without losing the revision you are viewing.
Retain guidance and reusable assets in identity packs. Share packs by ZIP so another project can begin with the same visual language.
Export H.264 MP4 or silent ProRes 4444 overlays with transparency. Import audio when the work needs it.
prompt: Use Unfold to animate how a request moves from a caller through tools and back as an artifact. Read unfold --help, help me configure the renderer and model, and open the animation for review. Use motion and geometry with minimal text.
prerequisites: Python 3.12+, Git, uv, Node.js, and FFmpeg with FFprobe. Follow the tool guide to prepare the pinned renderer dependencies.
model_note: Creative work needs separately configured OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini access with a vision-capable model. Managing retained work and rendering existing compositions need no model.

capability_demos.title: Create an identity. Share it. Make it your own.
capability_demos.description: Build a visual identity for your team, then export it as an Unfold identity pack. Teammates can import its guidance and reusable assets, and remix them in their own motion ideas.
capability_demos.alt: The MADE identity pack, its transparent title and corner-mark overlays composited over the Possibly demo, and the approved team bumper.
capability_demos.caption: Export a team identity pack. Reuse its transparent overlays on real demo footage, then close with the matching team bumper.
